battle.name: 南定州之戰
battle.brief: 開皇九年隋滅陳之役中，隋軍益州總管一線自蜀道南下，收陳朝在滇東所置的南寧州，改稱南定州。陳朝守軍倚南寧州城與爨氏、俚僚部眾固守，隋軍備撞車、雲梯攻堅，城上守軍以秦連弩連珠發射，把逼近城下的攻軍壓在弩程之外，州城最後易主。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 南定州之戰爆發於隋文帝開皇九年（589）隋滅陳之役的高潮期，交戰的一方是承北周而來的隋朝，一方是江南的陳朝，以及陳朝在滇東設置的南寧州（後稱南定州）軍政體系。隋朝方面以益州總管王益為主將，率益州、漢中兩地的兵馬，以及歸附的巴、蜀、僰、氐羌諸部人馬，隸屬行軍元帥晉王楊廣調度下的西南戰線；中央以楊廣坐鎮武昌，益州總管楊秀與各道行軍總管遙相策應。陳朝方面，守軍由陳朝任命的南寧州刺史與州吏率領，並有爨氏餘部，以及滇中俚僚、氐羌諸部的渠帥與部眾，據南寧州城和附屬的羈縻城堡、寨柵、村寨。雲南自東晉以來長期由爨氏控制，陳朝於滇東、南中設州置吏，等於在爨氏的勢力範圍內安插朝廷命官，因此陳朝末年的南寧州既是州治所在，也是隋軍進軍雲南的灘頭堡。此役雙方都未以中央正規軍的完整編制交鋒：隋軍是正軍與歸附部眾混合的兵力，陳朝方面則依託城防與山地部眾的機動性。
countriesEn: The Battle of Nanding Prefecture was fought in 589, at the height of the Sui war of conquest against the Chen dynasty. One side was the Sui court, which had inherited the empire of Northern Zhou; the other was the Chen dynasty together with the Chen administrative and military apparatus in eastern Yunnan, that is, the prefecture of Nanning, later renamed Nanding. On the Sui side the operation was led by Wang Yi, Commander of Yizhou, drawing on troops and horses from Yizhou and Hanzhong together with submitted Ba, Shu, Bo and Di-Qiang tribal contingents; it fell under the southwestern front commanded by the Prince of Jin, Yang Guang, the Commander-in-Chief, who sat at Wuchang, with Yang Xiu, the other Commander of Yizhou, and the commanders on every circuit supporting the line. On the Chen side the garrison was made up of the prefect and the local officials appointed by the Chen court, together with the remnants of the Cuan clan and the chieftains and warriors of the Dian, Di and Qiang peoples of the central and southern Yunnan region, holding the city of Nanning and the dependent stockades, forts and villages around it. Yunnan had been under Cuan control since the Eastern Jin, and the establishment of prefectures and officials in eastern Yunnan by the Chen was in effect an intrusion on the Cuan sphere of influence, so that Nanning at the end of the Chen was at once a prefectural seat and the bridgehead for a Sui army entering Yunnan. Neither side fought with the full establishment of a central field army: the Sui force mixed regulars with submitted tribal contingents, while the Chen side relied on its fortifications and on the mobility of the mountain peoples.
people: 隋文帝楊堅在開皇九年正月下詔發兵五十一萬八千人伐陳，晉王楊廣以行軍元帥坐鎮武昌，總攬各路大軍；益州總管王益奉詔率軍南下，出蜀道趨南中，是南定州方向的實際統兵主將。陳朝方面，後主陳叔寶在建康被隋軍所破，陳氏政權在江南崩潰，南寧州一線的守軍因中樞失去詔令與糧餉支援而陷於孤立，州刺史與爨氏、俚僚首領只能依據城壘自行抵禦。嶺南方面，俚族領袖冼夫人以高涼為基地，遣孫馮盎率部眾助隋平陳，是隋朝在南方少數以招撫而收兵於戰陣的關鍵人物之一，其辦法對南定州方向具有示範作用：隋朝在南中大量招撫地方首領、授以官爵、仍其部落習俗。須要說明的是，現存史籍對此役將帥姓名的記載極為疏略，南寧州守將與爨氏首領的姓名多有缺載，只能從《隋書》高祖紀與《資治通鑑》開皇九年至十年之間的相關記載中拼湊出一個大致輪廓；至於滇東戰場的實際經過，細節多已不可考。
peopleEn: Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, issued the order to raise 518,000 men against Chen in the first month of the ninth year of Kaihuang (589), and the Prince of Jin, Yang Guang, took command at Wuchang as Commander-in-Chief to direct the advancing columns. Wang Yi, Commander of Yizhou, was ordered to march south through the roads of Shu into Nanzhong, and he was the field commander actually responsible on the Nanding axis. On the Chen side, Emperor Hou, Chen Shubao, was broken at Jiankang while the Chen state collapsed in the Jiangnan; the garrison of Nanning, cut off from the decrees and supplies of the capital, was left isolated, and the prefect together with the Cuan and indigenous chieftains could only rely on their own walls and stores. In Lingnan, the powerful chieftain Lady Xian, based at Gaoliang, sent her grandson Feng Ang with his warriors to aid the Sui conquest of Chen; she was one of the clearest cases in the south of a force won by persuasion rather than by battle alone, and her methods served as a model for the Nanding operation, where the Sui court recruited local leaders in large numbers, granted them official titles and left their tribal customs intact. It must be said that the surviving records are extremely thin on the names of the commanders in this battle: the names of the Nanning prefect and of the Cuan chieftains are largely missing, and the outline has to be reconstructed from the Kaihuang annals in the History of Sui and from the corresponding passages of the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance for the ninth and tenth years of Kaihuang. As for the actual course of the fighting in eastern Yunnan, the details are no longer recoverable.
kits: 本卡兵器是秦連弩，即以弩機儲存拉力、上弦之後可以連續扣發的強弩機關。《三國志》記載諸葛亮作木鵰石弩，一發十矢；曹魏馬鈞又改良為可轉輪連射的連弩，這種連弩在此後數百年仍是守城與野戰的制壓武器。南定州之戰的守方據城而守，攻城者以密集隊形逼近時，弩矢可連珠而發，不必像單發弩那樣反覆上弦拉弦，因此能在短時間內形成壓制性的射擊面，把城下的進攻部隊壓在弩程之外；守軍也可用它封鎖城門、缺口與壕溝兩側，掩護守軍輪換，並填補被攻毀的城段。進攻方隋軍的攻城裝備則是撞車、雲梯與壕溝圍城的常規組合，配以步卒長槍、盾與輕騎掩護，惟史籍對此役所用器械的種類幾無記載，只能依同時期南朝、隋朝攻城戰的通例推想。糧秣方面，蜀道山高谷深，隋軍糧食主要由益州轉輸，弩手多為久經操練的步卒，弩機零件、弓弦與箭矢的耗損與補充同樣依賴後方供應。值得一提的是，滇東山區的部眾習慣使用竹木為桿、浸油為弦的短弩與標槍，與北方軍鎮配備的秦連弩在形制、射速及箭程上差距甚大，兩種遠射武器在雲南山地的表現因此大不相同。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Qin repeating crossbow, a strong crossbow whose trigger mechanism stores the draw force so that it can be released repeatedly without the bow being drawn again by hand. The Records of the Three Kingdoms describe Zhuge Liang as building a wooden-taloned stone crossbow that fired ten bolts in one go, and the Cao Wei craftsman Ma Jun later improved the type into a wheel-fed repeating crossbow; throughout the following centuries the repeating crossbow remained the standard means of holding down attackers and of dominating open ground in defence. At Nanding the defenders fought from the city walls. Whenever the Sui assault columns closed in below in dense formation, the bolts could be released in a continuous string, sparing the crews the slow cycle of cocking and loading that a single-shot crossbow demanded, so that a curtain of fire could be laid down in a few moments and keep the attackers outside the effective range of the walls. The same weapon could seal the gates, the breaches and both flanks of the ditch, covering the relief of the wall crews and the repair of damaged sections. The Sui assault train on the other side was the ordinary combination of battering rams, scaling ladders and a ring of ditches, supported by spearmen, shields and light cavalry, though the records say almost nothing about the machines actually used here, and only the general practice of Southern and Sui siegecraft can be used to infer them. Logistically, the roads of Shu ran through high gorges and deep valleys, and the Sui grain train came out of Yizhou; the crossbowmen were trained infantry, and the issue of replacement trigger-blocks, bowstrings and bolts depended on the same supply chain. It is worth noting that the mountain peoples of eastern Yunnan used short bows with bamboo-and-timber frames and oiled cord, together with javelins, and these behaved very differently from the northern repeating crossbow in frame, rate of fire and range.
tactics: 南定州方向的地形決定了作戰樣式。從益州南下，只有秦代開鑿的僰道（五尺道）與靈關道一線可以通行大軍，隊伍被拉成沿山道前進的長條，糧車、弩機、備用弓弦與箭袋只能由人力、馬匹分段擔運，前鋒與後衛之間的指揮傳遞都要靠驛騎往返。隋軍的戰法是先以輕騎與歸附部眾掃清沿途的城堡與部落寨柵，斷絕守軍外援，再以步卒主力進抵南寧州城下，築壕、列營，把攻城器械分段運到能發揮作用的位置。守軍依托州城與周邊山嶺，居高臨下以弩、礫石與火瓶壓制城下的作業隊形，避免與隋軍在寬闊平地上正面交鋒；同時把州城周邊的部落寨柵當作外圍支點，等待朝廷的詔令與援兵。隋朝在陳朝覆亡之後仍留兵於南中，一個重要原因是雲南並未因陳朝而亡就完全歸順，爨氏與各部渠帥仍據昆州等據點，隋軍必須以持久圍困與分化招撫並用，待到開皇十七年（597）才最後平定昆州。兩處關鍵據點相距不過百餘公里，卻拖了近八年，其間的攻守拉鋸，正是山地後勤與地方政治共同決定的結果。
tacticsEn: The terrain dictated the style of operations. Between Yizhou and the south there was only the Bo Route, the Five-Foot Road cut under the Qin, and the Lingguan Road wide enough for an army, so a column was stretched out along a mountain track, and the baggage carts, crossbow trigger-blocks, spare bowstrings and bolt bags had to be carried by porters and pack animals in stages; even orders travelled between the vanguard and the rear by relay riders. The Sui method was to clear the castles and tribal stockades on the way in with light cavalry and submitted contingents, cutting the defenders off from outside help, and then to bring the infantry up to the walls of Nanning, dig a ditch, lay out the camp and haul the siege machines forward in sections to the positions where they could work. The defenders, holding the city and the ridges around it, brought down bolts, stones and fire-pots from above onto the Sui working parties, avoided meeting the Sui in the open, and used the tribal stockades round the city as outlying points of support while waiting for decrees and relief from the capital. That the Sui had to keep troops in the south even after the fall of Chen is itself the point: Yunnan did not submit simply because Chen fell, and the Cuan and the local chieftains still held strongholds such as Kunzhou, so the Sui had to combine a protracted siege with a policy of separate peace and recruitment, and it was not until the seventeenth year of Kaihuang (597) that Kunzhou was finally taken. The two key points lay barely a hundred kilometres apart, yet the struggle over them ran on for close to eight years, a contest decided by mountain logistics and local politics together.
data: 可核對的數字並不多。隋文帝開皇九年正月，隋朝為滅陳舉兵五十一萬八千人，分西趨巴蜀與東線渡江等多路齊進，這是此役所屬大戰役的總兵力；南定州方向由益州總管一路出師，文獻提到益州方面出動的兵力達步騎二萬一類的規模，但此數是否單指滇東一線，史籍未加分別，使用時只能當作量級參考。距離上，益州治所成都到南寧州約一千五百里，中間要翻越數道山嶺，實際行軍往往按日行程數十里計算；南寧州到爨氏據守的昆州僅百餘公里山路，卻因分屬不同勢力而成為兩處互相不能支援的孤城。兵器方面，連弩的射速優勢來自弩機儲力，傳世記載稱一弩可連發十矢，弩手射速遠高於單發弩，卻也相應要求弩機、弓弦與箭矢的更換量成倍增加。時間上，隋軍自開皇九年末在滇東動兵，到開皇十年前後肅清南寧州一線，再經開皇十七年平定昆州，前後歷時近八年。戰役本身的傷亡數字，現存史料並無可靠記載，本篇不作推測。
dataEn: Few figures can be verified. In the first month of the ninth year of Kaihuang (589) the Sui raised 518,000 men for the destruction of Chen and advanced in several columns, one moving west into the Ba-Shu and others crossing the river in the east; that is the total strength of the great campaign to which this battle belongs. On the Nanding axis the force came from the Yizhou command, and the records speak of a Sui detachment out of Yizhou numbering some 20,000 foot and horse, but the figures are not distinguished by front, and the number can only be used as an order of magnitude. As for distance, some 1,500 li separate the seat of Yizhou at Chengdu from Nanning Prefecture, with several ranges in between, and marching was reckoned in tens of li a day; Nanning and the Cuan-held Kunzhou were only a little over a hundred kilometres apart along the mountain tracks, yet they were two isolated strongholds that could not support one another. As for weapons, the rate of fire of the repeating crossbow came from storing the draw in the trigger mechanism, and the received account has a single bow sending out ten bolts in succession; the crossbowman fired far faster than a single-shot bowman, but the consumption of trigger-blocks, bowstrings and bolts rose in proportion. In time, Sui forces moved in eastern Yunnan at the end of the ninth year of Kaihuang, cleared the Nanning line around the tenth year, and only settled Kunzhou in the seventeenth, a span of nearly eight years. Reliable casualty figures for the fighting itself do not survive in the sources, and none are invented here.
cause: 起因有三層。第一層是隋朝平陳的總體戰略：開皇八年（588）隋軍已取杭州，開皇九年正月大舉發兵，陳朝在江南各線迅速崩潰，而陳朝在雲南設置的南寧州仍懸於西南。隋朝不欲留下陳氏政權的西南殘部與爨氏、俚僚勢力聯合，故在主力東進的同時，另遣益州兵順勢收拾滇東。第二層是陳朝在滇東的權力本身就建立在安插官員、羈縻部落的脆弱安排上：陳霸先以來，陳朝以州刺史與校尉鎮撫南中，往往倚賴爨氏與渠帥的武力和歸附。一旦南寧州的官府失去建康中樞的詔命、印信與歲貢徵收的支持，守軍的彈藥、糧秣與賞賜無從籌措，士氣與忠誠便迅速鬆動。第三層是雲南本身的地理：從南中到中原的道路艱難，歷代王朝對滇東的控制多止步於設州置吏的間接治理，隋朝若不取南寧州，等於把陳朝在南方的最後一塊據點留給爨氏，讓昆州得以坐大。隋朝於是把此役視為平陳之後必須補上的西南一環。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause. The first is the general strategy of the Sui war against Chen: after taking Hangzhou in the eighth year of Kaihuang (588), the Sui court raised a great army in the first month of 589 and Chen collapsed quickly on every front in the south, but the Nanning Prefecture that the Chen had established in Yunnan still hung in the west. The Sui were unwilling to leave a Chen remnant in the south-west to unite with the Cuan and the indigenous chieftains, so a detachment was sent out of Yizhou to tidy up eastern Yunnan while the main effort went east. The second layer lies in the frailty of Chen power in eastern Yunnan, which rested on the installation of officials and the loose control of tribal groups: since Chen Baxian, the Chen had pacified Nanzhong through prefects and commandant officers, and had relied on the armed strength and the submission of the Cuan and the local chieftains. Once the Nanning administration lost the decrees, the seals and the regular revenue and tribute of the Jiankang court, there was no way to obtain ammunition, grain or pay, and the morale and loyalty of the garrison slackened quickly. The third layer is the geography of Yunnan itself: the roads between the far south and the Central Plains are hard, and through the ages the dynasties of China had governed eastern Yunnan for the most part indirectly, by setting up prefectures and officials. If the Sui did not take Nanning, the last Chen foothold in the south would be left to the Cuan and Kunzhou would be free to grow strong, so the Sui accordingly treated the operation as the south-western piece of the settlement that had to follow the destruction of Chen.
impact: 此役的直接結果，是陳朝在滇東的統治中斷，南寧州為隋朝所接收，改稱南定州，納入益州總管府的直接管轄，陳氏政權在西南不再有立足之地。放到全局看，開皇九年的這一年同時決定了南北命運：陳朝覆亡，隋朝統一長江流域，中國由長期分裂轉入隋唐一統的軌道；而雲南自漢武帝置郡以來屢有置廢，這次改置南定州，說明中原王朝對滇東的經營由設郡而治轉為設州而駐兵的走向。南寧州的歸附也為後來打通由益州經南中通往嶺南與天竺的交通線提供了起點，隋唐時期通往西南的驛道與商路，大體沿著這次軍事行動所確立的線路延伸，雲南與中原的物資、人員往還更為頻繁，就地徵發的俚僚部眾被編入隋軍與州鎮，成為唐宋南詔之前雲南地方武力的基礎。武器層面上，以連弩為代表的守城強弩在隋唐邊鎮沿用不衰，長期是城防與軍寨的標準配備。昆州的爨氏則仍以另一種政體的形式殘存，直到開皇十七年才被平定，可見一場戰役的結果與區域秩序的真正確立之間，往往還有漫長的距離。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the battle was that Chen rule in eastern Yunnan was broken: Nanning Prefecture passed to the Sui, was renamed Nanding, and was brought under the direct authority of the Yizhou command, and the Chen house no longer had a footing in the south-west. Placed in the larger frame, the single year 589 settled the fate of north and south alike: Chen fell, the Sui united the Yangtze valley, and China moved from long division onto the course of Sui-Tang unity. Because Yunnan had been made a commandery and then dropped, suppressed and re-established over the centuries, the renaming of Nanning as Nanding shows the engagement of the Central Plains with eastern Yunnan turning from ruling by an indirectly administered commandery towards a prefecture with troops stationed in it. The submission of Nanning also gave a starting point to the road that would link Yizhou through Nanzhong to Lingnan and to India; the post roads and caravan tracks of the Sui and Tang followed broadly the line fixed by this military movement, traffic in goods and people between Yunnan and the Central Plains grew denser, and the indigenous contingents levied on the spot were incorporated into the Sui army and the prefectural garrisons, becoming the base of the local military power of Yunnan before the Nanzhao state. At the level of arms, the strong repeating crossbow represented by this card passed into Sui and Tang frontier service without interruption and remained standard equipment for city walls and military stations. The Cuan at Kunzhou, however, survived as a separate polity until they were put down in the seventeenth year of Kaihuang, which shows how far the real consolidation of a regional order can lag behind the result of a single battle.
result: 南定州之戰以隋軍取勝告終：陳朝在南寧州的官署與守軍被清除或降附，州城易主，隋朝把南寧州改置為南定州，編入益州總管府，設官屬籍、徵收租調，滇東重新回到中原王朝的直接管轄之下。陳朝亡國之後，中原與江南的物資、人丁與技術大批南遷，雲南本地則首次出現大批北方移民所帶去的農具、鐵器與城防技術，南寧州的城牆與屯田據點在隋代曾經一度擴建，後來唐代南詔崛起時仍可看見其痕跡。對南中各部而言，隋朝的做法並非單純鎮壓：能歸附者授以官爵，能留籍者仍其習俗，因此雲南與中原的政治關係在隋唐之際維持了近一個世紀的穩定，直到南詔勢力坐大才再度緊張。殘留問題仍有二：其一，爨氏據守的昆州未被併入，隋朝在滇西方向仍要留兵設防；其二，此役之後滇東的州縣建置一度反覆，隋末唐初的南寧、昆兩州分立，正源於此戰留下的權力真空。總體而言，這是一場規模不大、記載稀少，卻在隋朝統一藍圖中佔據西南樞紐位置的一場戰役。
resultEn: The battle ended in a Sui victory: the Chen administration and garrison of Nanning were removed or submitted, the city changed hands, and the Sui renamed Nanning Prefecture as Nanding, brought it under the Yizhou command, installed officials and registers, and levied rent and taxes, so that eastern Yunnan returned once more to the direct rule of a dynasty of the Central Plains. With the fall of Chen, goods, population and techniques moved in bulk from the north and the Jiangnan into the south, and for the first time Yunnan received large numbers of iron tools, ironworking and fortification skills carried north; the walls of Nanning and its garrison farms were extended for a time under the Sui, and traces of them could still be seen when Nanzhao rose in the Tang. For the peoples of Nanzhong the Sui approach was not simple repression: those who submitted were given office and title, and those who stayed were left with their customs, so that relations between Yunnan and the Central Plains remained stable for close to a century, until the rise of Nanzhao tightened them again. Two problems remained. First, the Cuan-held Kunzhou was not absorbed, so the Sui still had to station troops and build defences to the west. Second, the arrangement of prefectures in eastern Yunnan was unstable for a time after the battle; the division of the late Sui and early Tang into the two prefectures of Nanning and Kun grew directly out of the power vacuum left here. On the whole this was a small, poorly recorded engagement, and yet one that held a south-western hinge in the Sui unification scheme.
